verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is a comprehensive, well-documented partner API/platform explicitly designed for embedding payroll, HR, benefits, and contractor payments into third-party products, with pre-built UI flows, webhooks, idempotency, and multi-state/tax handling. Extensive first-party docs and a verified live documentation site confirm this is a mature, purpose-built offering, though evidence is vendor-sourced with no independent developer reviews.
